name: Csősz (Hungary)
description: Green swallow-tailed field charged towards the hoist with the municipal arms of Csősz (a blue shield with a yellow lion, with a helm and red, blue and yellow mantling) above the name CSŐSZ in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Csősz arms with helm and mantling
